_help: Gear fit bot (scripts/FitBot.cs; tools/run.ps1 fit / fit-tune). Dresses mannequins in every weapon, shield and armor piece, poses them, measures and photographs. The body is measured as capsules between bones; radii come from each body's own mesh (radiusPercentile of the vertex distances). Distances in metres. Item names come from data/items.json itemNames.
_racesHelp: an empty list = every race in data/races.json

poses._help: [clip key from data/avatar.json clips, fraction of the clip, combo step]. Pose sets: checked and photographed (first pose). warn = checked, reported as warnings only (attack swings).

tune._help: fit-tune: coordinate search around the current values; it writes bot_out/fit/fit_suggest.json and changes nothing itself.
